about: The asset library's packs this runtime's own names resolve in, in order: a world template's prop ids, a spec's body id, a default's "library:<id>", the voxel world's block faces. Assets live in library/packs (builder/art/views.mjs reads them); this file holds no art. A kind's preset ranks packs for open slots; this order only says which pack a bare id means when two packs use it.
